lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular pixel clusters organized into at least four vertical columns posterior to the gill area, forming a regular 2D grid pattern across the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher luminance intersect with horizontal rows of white blobs, creating defined anchor nodes within a grid-like matrix on the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the dorsal side to a shadowed boundary below.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density distribution of small, high-luminance circular spots localized on the dorsal surface and leading edge of the pectoral fin.
